claims.statement: Official latest stable observed 2026-10-31 is v1.3.0, published 2026-10-19; this is an evaluated candidate, not the selected dependency.
Candidate manifest requires PHP ^8.3, Illuminate ^12.0|^13.0, json-schema ^12.62|^13.15; no framework dependency is added to AgenTools core.
The direct protocol pins anthropic-version 2026-10-21, the current documented version. Generation options removed in this version are not silently sent.
POST /v1/messages is one model exchange, with separate system instructions, messages, client tool definitions, max_tokens and output_config; no application tool handler is executed by this endpoint.
Client tool_use IDs are replayed as tool_result.tool_use_id. Server tools execute remotely and are excluded from this selected vertical.
SSE documents message_start, content deltas, cumulative message_delta usage, message_stop and in-stream errors. Missing/duplicate terminal are adapter errors, not successful completion.
HTTP errors and post-200 stream errors are distinct; a transport interruption does not prove zero usage or a failed Action.
Exact v1.3.0 StepTextGateway exposes public generateTextStep and generateStreamStep. The HTTP fake experiment extracts toolu_stable with zero handler invocations and exactly one HTTP request.

Complete, missing-terminal and duplicate-terminal scripted streams all return the same normalized event types and finish=stop from public generateStreamStep. Terminal presence/count cannot be recovered from these normalized outputs. This disqualifies A for required streaming without replacing the streaming path or inspecting internal/vendor APIs.

Missing usage normalizes to input/output zero in the candidate. Synchronous raw response allows an adapter to recover absence, so this alone does not disqualify A. Public streaming does not expose equivalent raw terminal proof.

SDK approval storage and per-step events do not establish AgenTools fenced durable callbacks, current host permissions, exactly-once proposal mapping or unknown-effect reconciliation. No B durable recovery proof was executed.

The standalone probe and repository tests exercise direct wire normalization and fail-closed preconditions with scripted IO only. Execution evidence is indexed in focused-checks.json; no provider, production adapter or durable runtime loop is thereby qualified.
Existing agentools/sdk PHP >=8.3, LlmPort::respond(array):array and ScenarioRunner remain unchanged. This item adds research documents and standalone probes only.
Select direct Anthropic Messages protocol with AgenTools as sole future durable loop owner. SDK package/version are null. P1.4 owns package naming and P4.2 owns the actual driver implementation.
Native JSON output uses output_config.format type=json_schema; model-specific schema restrictions, refusals and truncation require explicit handling.
Direct authentication and workspace scope must be resolved from trusted tenant/account credential refs. x-api-key remains documented for workspace-scoped API keys; no secret is read by this probe.

decisions.decision: Select direct Anthropic Messages 2026-10-21 with AgenTools-owned loop; SDK package/version null.
decisions.rationale: Required raw stream terminal/error semantics remain observable without replacing SDK streaming or creating another loop; no dependency or schema changes in current SDK.

limitations: This is a recorded transport selection and offline contract evidence, not an implemented ModelTransport, durable runtime loop, provider support guarantee or production readiness.
loop_proven remains false. AgenTools durable storage, confirmation, CAS/fencing, effect reconciliation and delivery/usage deduplication belong to later owners and were not executed here.
Required transport features remain required for both read and write. Optional restrictions describe the selected initial driver surface, not global Anthropic inability.
Probe JSON schema validation is intentionally a bounded fixture subset; full supported dialect validation and real cancellation during IO remain P4.2 work.
CapabilitySnapshot in tests is synthetic. No model/account/deployment/legal/region/price/quality qualification was obtained; unknown/expired evidence must not route real requests.
SDK v1.3.0 isolated install is research-only, not a target pin. Donor v0.6.8 is not installed or inherited. A could be reconsidered only after exact public streaming boundary evidence changes.

Perplexity researcher was unavailable before execution; official primary sources were retrieved directly. Initial standalone SDK streaming setup needed ramsey/uuid; isolated dependency repaired and failure evidence retained.
Acceptance V1-V4 are coordinator-owned and not run by executor. The focused-checks.json records only actual focused commands; no per-V PASS receipt is fabricated.
